bodies: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology

exams.name: NIC Advanced Micropigmentation Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: National written examination on advanced micropigmentation techniques, pigment science, infection control and client assessment.

exams.name: NIC Advanced Practice Esthetics Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on national examination on advanced esthetic modalities such as chemical exfoliation, microdermabrasion and light-based treatments.

exams.name: NIC Advanced Practice Esthetics Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written national examination covering advanced and combined esthetics practice, skin physiology, device safety and contraindications.

exams.name: NIC Barber 1 (No Chemical) Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Practical examination for restricted barber licences covering haircutting and shaving without chemical service components.

exams.name: NIC Barber 1 (No Chemical) Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination for barber licences that exclude chemical services, focusing on cutting, shaving, sanitation and safety.

exams.name: NIC Barber Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on national barbering examination covering haircutting, shaving, chemical services and infection control procedures.

exams.name: NIC Barber Styling Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Practical national examination for barber stylists covering styling, chemical waving, colour and disinfection procedures.

exams.name: NIC Barber Styling Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written national examination for barber stylist licensure covering chemical services, hair structure, styling and safety practice.

exams.name: NIC Barber Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Multiple-choice national written examination used by state boards for barber licensure, covering science, hair and skin services.

exams.name: NIC Blow Dry Styling Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Practical examination for limited blow dry styling licences covering shampooing, thermal styling and disinfection procedures.

exams.name: NIC Blow Dry Styling Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination for blow dry styling licensure covering hair and scalp basics, thermal tools, products and infection control.

exams.name: NIC Body Piercing Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on national examination on aseptic setup, needle handling, jewellery insertion and post-procedure care for body piercers.

exams.name: NIC Body Piercing Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written national examination on anatomy, sterilisation, bloodborne pathogens, jewellery materials and client aftercare for piercers.

exams.name: NIC Cosmetology Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on licensure examination with a hair core plus optional facial, hair removal, manicure and sculptured nail sections.

exams.name: NIC Cosmetology Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: National 110-question written examination on scientific concepts plus hair, skin and nail care services used by most state boards.

exams.name: NIC Cosmetology Written Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Scenario-based written alternative to the hands-on cosmetology practical, testing procedure sequencing and safety judgement.

exams.name: NIC Electrology Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on examination in probe insertion, epilation technique, equipment setup and infection control for electrologist licensure.

exams.name: NIC Electrology Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written licensure examination on hair growth cycles, electrolysis modalities, skin anatomy, sterilisation and client consultation.

exams.name: NIC Esthetics Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on esthetician licensure examination covering facial treatment, extraction, masks, hair removal and infection control.

exams.name: NIC Esthetics Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: National written examination for esthetician licensure covering skin sciences, treatments, products, devices and safe practice.

exams.name: NIC Eyelash and Eyebrow Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Practical examination covering eyelash extension application, eyebrow shaping, adhesive safety and sanitation for limited licences.

exams.name: NIC Hair Design Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on examination in cutting, chemical waving, colour application and thermal styling for hair designer licence categories.

exams.name: NIC Hair Design Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination for hair-only licence categories covering hair structure, chemical services, styling theory and disinfection.

exams.name: NIC Hair Removal Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Practical examination on soft and hard waxing, threading, tweezing and post-treatment care for hair removal specialty licences.

exams.name: NIC Hair Removal Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination on temporary hair removal methods, skin analysis, contraindications and infection control for specialty licences.

exams.name: NIC Instructor Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Teaching demonstration examination assessing lesson delivery, clinic supervision and student evaluation for beauty school instructors.

exams.name: NIC Instructor Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination on teaching methods, curriculum, classroom management and assessment for cosmetology and barbering instructors.

exams.name: NIC Nail Technology Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on examination covering manicure, pedicure, sculptured nail and tip application plus implement disinfection procedures.

exams.name: NIC Nail Technology Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: National written examination for manicurist and nail technician licensure covering nail anatomy, products, services and sanitation.

exams.name: NIC National Manager Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination for salon manager licence categories covering supervision, sanitation enforcement, records and business practice.

exams.name: NIC Natural Hair Styling Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Practical examination covering braiding, twisting, locking and extension techniques performed without chemical services.

exams.name: NIC Natural Hair Styling Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written examination for natural hair stylist and braider licences covering textured hair care, scalp health, tools and sanitation.

exams.name: NIC Permanent Cosmetics/Micropigmentation Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written national examination on permanent makeup procedures, pigments, skin anatomy, sterilisation and bloodborne pathogen control.

exams.name: NIC Tattooing Practical Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Hands-on examination on workstation setup, machine handling, aseptic technique and aftercare instruction for tattoo artists.

exams.name: NIC Tattooing Theory Examination
exams.body: National-Interstate Council of State Boards of Cosmetology
exams.blurb: Written national tattooing examination covering skin anatomy, pigments, equipment, sterilisation and bloodborne pathogen standards.
